resolution: Highest stable published v5 SemVer tag from live upstream refs (git ls-remote origin), prereleases excluded. The local checkout HEAD equaled the tag's peeled commit at resolution time, so the export is the tag content.

snapshot.digest_definition: SHA-256 of the snapshot's SHA256SUMS manifest; the manifest itself lists every snapshot file with its SHA-256, LC_ALL=C sorted
snapshot.export_method: git archive 7d571cef0bde3955bf5fb9593ab1a209cbe237b3 skills/deepworkplan | tar -x (real copy; live symlinks prohibited)

policy: The comparator never changes during a campaign. Recheck the upstream tag list at the confirmation freeze; a newer v5 becomes a new recorded comparator and the affected calibration is redone. The stale vendored dogfood (5.4.0) is never a comparator.
